releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.EthereumOASIS v2.0.5

Connects the OASIS to Ethereum -- the world's leading smart contract platform. Stores OASIS holons, avatars, and NFTs on-chain, interacts with EVM-compatible contracts, and participates in the Ethereum DeFi ecosystem. Fully integrated with the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture -- switch to or from Ethereum at runtime with zero code changes. Write-Once-Deploy-Everywhere across 55+ providers. REST API: https://api.web4.oasisomniverse.one | Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one
